prompt: 我第一次碰 Kafka。我們的 invoice-mailer consumer 每次 deploy 之後，有些客戶會收到兩封一樣的 invoice email。code 在 evals/files/kafka-consumer/consumer.py。可以幫我修嗎？但我想搞懂到底發生什麼事，不要只丟一個 fix 給我。
assertions: Response is written primarily in Traditional Chinese
Keeps Kafka technical terms (offset, consumer group, commit, rebalance) in English
Identifies offset / auto-commit timing as a key missing concept
Introduces delivery semantics (at-least-once) or equivalent idea that duplicates are expected without idempotency
Anchors the model to something the user likely knows (e.g. a job queue) and names where the analogy breaks
Asks the user for a prediction before implementing the fix
Does not deliver a full rewritten consumer in the first turn
